title: MCP stage_place_instance accepts non-symbol library item IDs silently
description:
stage_place_instance in registry.ts (line 815) uses doc.library.items.find((i) => i.id === params.symbolId) with NO itemType filter. If a bitmap, sound, video, or font item's ID is passed, the lookup succeeds and the tool proceeds to create a SymbolInstance display object (type: 'instance') with symbolId pointing to a non-symbol item. This produces a broken display object that references a non-symbol, causing undefined behavior during compile/render.

Additionally, there is NO MCP tool for placing bitmap items on the stage (BitmapDisplayObject). The only tools available are:
- stage_place_instance (symbols only)
- stage_add_shape (raw shapes)
- stage_add_text (text)
- stage_add_video (video items)
- library_import_bitmap (imports to library, no placement)

An agent that imports a bitmap via library_import_bitmap and then tries to place it via stage_place_instance will silently create a broken SymbolInstance.

FIX 1: Add itemType validation in stage_place_instance. At line 815, change the find() to filter on itemType === 'symbol', OR add an explicit check after the find() and throw a clear error: 'Item X is a bitmap, not a symbol. Use stage_add_bitmap to place bitmaps on stage.'

FIX 2: Add a stage_add_bitmap MCP tool that creates a BitmapDisplayObject (type: 'bitmap') referencing a BitmapItem. Modelled after stage_add_video. Parameters: bitmapItemId, x, y, width?, height?, scaleX?, scaleY?, rotation?, alpha?, blendMode?, colorEffect?, instanceName?, layerId?, frameIndex?.

FILES:
- packages/authoring-ui/src/agent/registry.ts (stage_place_instance validation, line 815; add stage_add_bitmap)
- packages/vite-plugin-agent-mcp/src/index.ts (add stage_add_bitmap MCP schema; already has stage_add_video pattern to copy)
- packages/agent-protocol/src/index.ts (register new tool name)
